key_decisions.original_text: EIP-8037 SELFDESTRUCT gas refill not added to Glamsterdam; deferred to Hegota with proper EIP
DFI for Hegota: EIP-7609 (TLOAD/TSTORE cost decrease), EIP-8058 (bytecode deduplication discount) — no champion; EIP-8360 (TCREATE) retained as placeholder
EIP-8141 (Frames) SFI for Hegota; spec may still change; SFI status must not impede continued L2 collaboration or spec iteration
